title: Validate negative quantities
body: Reject invalid input before calculating a total.
diff:
diff --git a/src/demo_calculator.py b/src/demo_calculator.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/demo_calculator.py
+++ b/src/demo_calculator.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 def calculate_total(quantity: int, unit_price: int) -> int:
+    if quantity < 0:
+        raise ValueError("quantity must be non-negative")
     return quantity * unit_price

changed_files.patch:
